definitions.gloss: resident; occupant; tenant; person who moves in
definitions.explanation: A person who moves into and lives in a dwelling, facility, or building. Used for apartments, care facilities, and similar residences.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{入居者|にゅうきょしゃ}が{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}してきた。
{入居者|にゅうきょしゃ}{募集|ぼしゅう}の{広告|こうこく}を{出|だ}した。
examples.english: We put out an advertisement looking for tenants.

examples.japanese: この{老人|ろうじん}ホームの{入居者|にゅうきょしゃ}は、{毎朝|まいあさ}ラジオ{体操|たいそう}をしている。
examples.english: The residents of this nursing home do radio calisthenics every morning.

notes:
Compound of {入居|にゅうきょ} (moving in, taking up residence) + {者|しゃ} (person). Used in both real estate and care facility contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {入居者|にゅうきょしゃ}{募集|ぼしゅう}: seeking tenants/residents
- {入居者|にゅうきょしゃ}{募集中|ぼしゅうちゅう}: now accepting residents
- {入居者|にゅうきょしゃ}{向|む}けサービス: services for residents
- {新規|しんき}{入居者|にゅうきょしゃ}: new tenant/resident

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {居住者|きょじゅうしゃ}: resident, inhabitant — more formal and general; can refer to anyone living somewhere
- {住人|じゅうにん}: resident, dweller — more casual; emphasizes being a longtime inhabitant
- テナント: tenant (loanword) — typically used for commercial tenants in a building
